headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense and Sandy Alcantara dominating on the mound. Hicks hit 3 home runs, including a 2-run shot, while Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Coleman Crow, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The injury is retroactive to June 10, 2026. Other notable injuries include Chase Dollander's right elbow strain, Seth Lugo's concussion, Brent Rooker's bone bruise in his left knee, Ramón Urías's right elbow lateral epicondylitis, Adolis García's right latissimus dorsi tear, Daulton Varsho's left wrist inflammation, and Javier Báez's right ankle sprain.

The Chicago White Sox made a significant move, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. Additionally, the White Sox traded RF Derek Hill and other considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers also made a trade, acquiring RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Bryce Miller led the way with 8.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs allowed.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense, going 3-for-3 with a home run and an RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The injury is retroactive to June 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
